subject: Azure Marketplace: SKUs, co-sell entitlements and technical sign-off plan

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jeremy Liu <jeremy.liu@contoso.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:02:00 +0000
Subject: Azure Marketplace: initial SKU mapping and co-sell ask

Hi Jeremy —

Thanks again for agreeing to take the Marketplace path for the integration. To keep timelines tight for Q1 co-sell enablement, here are the concrete things we need to land in the next 7 business days: 

1) SKU mapping (your canonical SKU ids -> offer SKUs).
2) Updated draft manifest.json with pricing tiers and telemetry/usage properties (we need the SKU ids in the manifest).
3) High-level security evidence (SOC2 scope / data residency statement) we can attach to the marketplace listing.
4) Confirmation of the Contoso legal entity and MPN/Publisher ID (we'll forward Microsoft the publisher proofs).

Can you send the SKU CSV and a draft manifest by EOD Wed (Dec 2)? If helpful, we can run a quick validation pass on our side and coordinate with the Azure team. Proposed 30-min slot for an alignment call: Thu Dec 3, 10:00–10:30 CET — does that work for you?

I pasted a short checklist below that Jonas and I will use to validate when we receive the files.

Thanks —
Marissa
Director, GTM Engineering
Redwood Inference

---
Redwood validation checklist (high level):
- SKU ids present and stable across pricing tiers
- manifest.json contains required offerId, publisherId, and sku entries
- Pricing plan types (metered vs. subscription) clearly annotated
- Evidence for data residency and retention policy attached
- Any third-party deps called out (containers, connectors)

Attachment: none in this message

From: Azure Marketplace Validation <azure-marketplace@microsoft.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Jeremy Liu <jeremy.liu@contoso.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Azure Marketplace: initial SKU mapping and co-sell ask

Hi Marissa / team —

Thanks for the note and timeline. A few validation items from our side to ensure a smooth publisher activation and co-sell assignment: 

- Publisher identity: we need MPN ID and preferred publisher display name (matches legal entity). If you (Contoso) already have a Publisher ID, include the portal screenshot or publisher.json export.
- Offer manifest: manifest.json must include the offerId and sku ids; please ensure the sku id strings match the CSV you plan to upload.
- Co-sell entitlements: add a property in the manifest under "coSell" with partnerOfferTag and a primary marketplace region in the metadata. This speeds up co-sell routing.
- Technical proofs: sample ARM template / container image reference and a short runbook of telemetry endpoints (we do not need full logs).
- Security artifacts: SOC2 report or attestation + statement on where customer data persists.

Portal resources: https://partner.microsoft.com/en-us/marketplace/offer/validate/tenant/12345

If you can share the manifest and SKU CSV before Thu, we can do a preflight validation and flag any blockers so they can be corrected before publisher activation. Also confirm your co-sell lead (internal contact) so we can tag the proper MS Sales team.

Regards,
Azure Marketplace Validation Team
Microsoft
